blocks.prompt:
1 What are macronutrients? Describe the role of nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium and magnesium in plants, with the effect of deficiency of each. (4 marks)
(Macronutrients kya hain? Plants mein nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium aur magnesium ka kirdar aur har aik ki kami ka asar bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Macronutrients woh nutrients hain jo nisbatan zyada miqdaar mein chahiye. Yeh nau hain: carbon, hydrogen, oxygen, nitrogen, potassium, calcium, phosphorus, magnesium aur sulphur.

Nitrogen: energy metabolism aur proteins banane mein bunyadi kirdar; growth ke liye zaroori. Kami: patte girna aur ruki growth.

Phosphorus: ATP ka hissa; jaron ki growth barhata aur phool aane mein madad deta hai. Kami: phool der se aana, patton ka bhoora aur jhurri daar hona.

Potassium: paani ke control aur zakheera substances ki transport mein shamil; photosynthesis barhata, tissue mazboot karta aur nitrates lene ko barhata hai. Kami: patton par gehre dhabbe.

Magnesium: chlorophyll molecule ka core, is liye photosynthesis ke liye zaroori; phosphorus ke jazb aur transport aur sugar ke zakheere mein madad. Kami: kamzor dandiyan, sab se purane patton ka hara pan khatam hona aur peele bhoore dhabbe.

book_ref.quote: Macronutrients are needed in relatively larger amounts

blocks.prompt:
2 Define micronutrients and name them. Describe the role and the deficiency symptom of iron, manganese, zinc and molybdenum. (4 marks)
(Micronutrients ki definition likh kar un ke naam batayein. Iron, manganese, zinc aur molybdenum ka kirdar aur kami ki alamat bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Micronutrients bohat kam miqdaar mein chahiye. Yeh saat hain: iron, manganese, zinc, molybdenum, copper, chlorine aur boron.

Iron: chlorophyll banane ke liye zaroori; energy transfer aur nitrogen metabolism ke enzymes ka cofactor. Kami: interveinal chlorosis.

Manganese: photosynthesis, nitrogen aur carbohydrate metabolism aur enzymes ko active karne mein shamil; superoxide dismutase (SOD) jaise antioxidant enzymes ke liye ahem jo oxidative stress kam karte hain. Kami: patte waqt se pehle girna aur der se pakna.

Zinc: chlorophyll, jaron ki development aur nutrients lene mein madad. Kami: ruki growth.

Molybdenum: nitrogen fixation, nitrogen reduction, sulfur aur phosphorus metabolism aur iron ke istemal ke liye zaroori. Kami: purane patton ki chlorosis aur ruki growth.

book_ref.quote: Micronutrients are needed in very smaller amounts

blocks.prompt:
3 Describe the structure of the trap in the pitcher plant and in the Venus-fly trap, and how each captures and uses its prey. (4 marks)
(Pitcher plant aur Venus-fly trap mein trap ki banawat, aur har aik shikar ko kaise pakarta aur istemal karta hai, bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Insectivorous plants asal autotrophs hain, magar yeh keeray pakar kar patton ke enzymes se torte hain; shikar ke nitrogenous compounds in ki growth tez karte hain.

Pitcher plant: patta thaili ya ghare (pitcher) mein badal jata hai jis mein kuch paani hota hai. Patte ka aakhri hissa dhakkan (hood) banata hai jo munh ko kuch dhakta hai. Andar bohat se sakht baal gire hue chhote keeron ko bahar rengne nahi dete aur enzymes unhein tor dete hain.

Venus-fly trap: har patte ke sire par do jure hue lobes ka trap hota hai. Lobes ki andar ki satah par trichomes (baal jaise ubhaar) hote hain jo shikar ke chhoone par lobes ko tezi se band karte hain. Kinaron par bareek bristles band hone par aapas mein phans jate hain, is liye shikar nahi bhaag sakta. Patte ke glands ke enzymes keeray ko hazam karte hain aur products jazb hote hain.

book_ref.quote: Venus-fly trap has a "trap" consisting of two lobes that are hinged at the end of each leaf

blocks.prompt:
4 Describe the structure of stomata. Explain how exchange of gases takes place through the leaf during day and night. (4 marks)
(Stomata ki banawat bayan karein. Din aur raat mein patte se gason ka tabadla kaise hota hai, samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Banawat: stomata (wahid stoma) plant tissues mein chhote surakh hain, aam tor par patton aur kuch tanon mein, jo gason ke tabadle ke liye zaroori hain. Har surakh ko do guard cells gherte hain jo bean ki shakal ke aur chloroplasts wale hain. Guard cells mahol ke mutabiq surakh kholte aur band karte hain aur is se transpiration ki raftaar control hoti hai.

Din: stomata khulte hain taake photosynthesis ke liye CO₂ andar aaye. CO₂ stomata se andar aa kar spongy mesophyll ki hawai jagahon se guzarti hai aur palisade mesophyll cells (ghane, chloroplasts se bhare, upper epidermis ke neeche) mein istemal hoti hai. Banne wali O₂ palisade cells se nikal kar spongy mesophyll se hoti hui stomata se bahar jati hai.

Raat: roshni na hone se photosynthesis ruk jati hai, is liye stomata paani bachane aur transpiration kam karne ke liye band ho jate hain. Plant phir bhi respiration karta hai, O₂ leta aur CO₂ chhorta hai.

book_ref.quote: However, plants still respire, taking in O₂ and releasing CO₂

blocks.prompt:
5 Compare the starch sugar hypothesis with the K⁺ influx hypothesis of stomatal movement. Name the hormone that can override both light and CO₂ and explain how. (4 marks)
(Stomata ki harkat ke starch sugar hypothesis aur K⁺ influx hypothesis ka muqabla karein. Woh hormone batayein jo roshni aur CO₂ dono ke asar ko khatam kar deta hai aur kaise.)
blocks.explanation:
Guard cells multisensory hydraulic valves ki tarah kaam karte hain; dono hypotheses batate hain ke in ka turgor kaise badalta hai.

Hormone: zyada garmi mein jab patte ke cells murjhane lagte hain to mesophyll cells abscisic acid chhorte hain. Yeh guard cells mein K⁺ ki active transport rok deta hai, roshni aur CO₂ ke asar ko bhi; K⁺ pumping ruk jati hai aur stomata band ho jate hain.

book_ref.quote: The guard cells function as multisensory hydraulic valves

rows: 1856 mein H. Van Mohl ne pesh kiya.
Guard cells mein K⁺ ki active transport par mabni.
Din: guard cells photosynthesis se sugar banate hain; water potential girta hai.
Din: K⁺ active tor par andar, osmotic potential kam hota hai.
Paani andar, guard cells turgid, stomata khulte hain.
Paani osmosis se andar, guard cells turgid, stomata khulte hain; blue light K⁺ ka dakhla barhati hai.
Raat: sugar starch ban jati ya respire hoti hai; paani nikalta, guard cells flaccid, stomata band.
Raat: K⁺ passive tor par nikalta hai; paani nikalta, guard cells flaccid, stomata band.
Turgor ki tez tabdeeli ki poori wazahat nahi.
Blue light ise barhati hai; abscisic acid ise rokta hai.

blocks.prompt:
6 Describe the structure, location and supporting role of collenchyma and sclerenchyma. (4 marks)
(Collenchyma aur sclerenchyma ki banawat, jagah aur sahara dene ka kirdar bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Collenchyma: khaas cells jo dhaariyon ya silinder ki shakal mein hote hain. In mein secondary wall nahi hoti; primary wall konon par cellulose ke izafi jamao se moti hoti hai. Yeh jawan tanon ki epidermis ke neeche, patte ki dandi mein aur rago ke saath hote hain. Tana ya patta lamba hone par yeh bhi lambe hote hain aur un jawan hisson ko sahara dete hain jin mein secondary growth nahi hui.

Sclerenchyma: cells jin ki moti secondary walls lignin se bhari hoti hain jo mazbooti aur sakhti deta hai. Zyada tar cells murda hain. Is ka asal kaam plant ke mukhtalif hisson ko sahara dena hai. Is ke do qisam ke cells hain:
Fibres: lambe aur silinder numa; xylem ke andar ghane bundles ya bundle caps ki shakal mein.
Sclereids: fibres se chhote; beej ke chhilke aur akhrot ke khol mein, jahan hifazat karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Collenchyma cells are specialized cells that are grouped in the form of strands or cylinders

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab mein sclerenchyma ki teen qisamen (fibres, sclereids, vessels) aur fibres ko tracheids likha hai; yeh ghalat hai. Sclerenchyma ke sirf do cells hain, fibres aur sclereids. Tracheids aur vessels xylem ke paani le jane wale cells hain.

blocks.prompt:
7 Explain solute potential and pressure potential and show how they make up the water potential of a plant cell. How does water potential decide the direction and speed of water movement? (4 marks)
(Solute potential aur pressure potential samjhayein aur batayein ke yeh plant cell ka water potential kaise banate hain. Water potential paani ki harkat ki simt aur raftaar kaise tay karta hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Water potential (Ψw) paani ke molecules ki kinetic energy par hai; jitne zyada molecules, utna zyada. Khalis paani ka Ψw sab se zyada hai jo definition se zero hai; har solution ka Ψw kam, yani negative hai. Plant cells mein do cheezen ise tay karti hain:

Solute potential (Ψs): solute molecules ki wajah se water potential mein tabdeeli. Yeh hamesha negative hai; zyada solute se aur kam (zyada negative).

Pressure potential (Ψp): water potential ka woh hissa jo paani ke dabao se hai. Atmospheric se zyada dabao water potential barhata hai. Jab paani osmosis se cell mein aata hai to dabao banta hai, cell turgid hota hai aur Ψp barhta hai.

Ψw = Ψs + Ψp

Simt aur raftaar: paani zyada Ψw se kam Ψw ki taraf jata hai; partially permeable membrane ke paar yeh osmosis hai. Yeh rujhan kisi bhi do systems ke darmiyan naapa ja sakta hai: cell se cell, mitti se jar, patte se hawa, mitti se hawa. Gradient jitna steep, bahao utna tez.

book_ref.quote: In plant cells, two factors determine water potential i.e., Solute potential

blocks.prompt:
8 Describe the uptake of water by roots and the three pathways by which water and minerals travel across the root to the xylem. (4 marks)
(Jaron se paani lene ka amal aur woh teen raste bayan karein jin se paani aur minerals jar ke paar xylem tak jate hain.)
blocks.explanation:
Jazb: jaren apni phaili shakhon se bari satah deti hain. Root hairs, jo epidermal cells ke barhe hue hisse hain, zyada tar paani aur minerals lete hain. Yeh mitti se active aur passive transport se epidermal cells mein, phir cortex mein aur phir jar ke beech ke xylem tak teen raston se jate hain:

1. Apoplast pathway: saath saath cell walls ke nizaam se musalsal rasta. Endodermis mein Casparian segments ki wajah se yeh toot jata hai.

2. Symplast pathway: jar ke cells ke jure hue protoplasts se, jo plasmodesmata (walls ke surakhon se guzarti cytoplasm ki dhaariyan) se jure hain. Yeh kam ahem hai, siwaye endodermis ke ilaqe mein minerals ke.

3. Vacuolar pathway: cell membranes, cytoplasm, tonoplast aur vacuoles se, aik vacuole se doosre tak, baqi do raston ko chhor kar. Is raste se harkat na hone ke barabar hai.

book_ref.quote: From root epidermis, they move to cortex, and then into the xylem tissue in the centre of root

blocks.prompt:
9 Describe the structure of xylem tissue, giving the features and role of each of its components. (4 marks)
(Xylem tissue ki banawat bayan karein, har hisse ki khususiyat aur kirdar ke saath.)
blocks.explanation:
Xylem woh vascular tissue hai jo paani aur hal shuda minerals jaron se tane aur patton tak le jata hai; yeh plant ko mechanical sahara bhi deta hai. Is ke chaar hisse hain:

Tracheids: lambe, patle cells jin ki walls lignin se moti aur sire patle hain; bordered pits se jure hain jo paani ko pehlu ki taraf jane dete hain.

Vessels: tracheids se chhote aur chaure, seedhi qatar mein musalsal naliyan banate hain; perforation plates paani ko asani se guzarne dete hain.

Xylem fibres: lambe cells jin ki walls lignin se moti hain, pakne par murda; xylem ko mazbooti aur izafi sahara dete hain.

Xylem parenchyma: zinda patli wall wale cells jo nutrients aur paani rakhte, pehlu ki taraf transport karte aur xylem ki marammat aur dobara banne mein madad dete hain.

book_ref.quote: It is also a key structural component which provides mechanical support to the plant body

blocks.prompt:
10 Explain the TACT mechanism of the movement of water through xylem from roots to leaves. (4 marks)
(Jaron se patton tak xylem mein paani ki harkat ka TACT mechanism samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
TACT (Transpiration, Adhesion, Cohesion, Tension) aam tor par maana hua model hai ke paani gravity ke khilaf xylem mein kaise upar jata hai. Yeh paani ki physical aur chemical khususiyat aur plant ke mahol se taalluq par mabni hai.

Transpiration: paani stomata ke zariye patte ki satah se bhaap ban kar urta hai. Bhaap nikalne se patte ke tissue mein manfi dabao banta hai; yeh kheench paani ko jaron se tane ke raste upar lati hai. Yehi asal quwwat hai.

Adhesion: paani ke molecules aur xylem walls ki kashish. Paani upar jate hue walls se chipakta hai aur column nahi tootta, khaas kar lambe plants mein jahan gravity zyada kheenchti hai.

Cohesion: paani ke molecules ki aapas ki kashish, hydrogen bonding se. Paani jaron se patton tak na tootne wala column banata hai, is liye patte ki kheench poore column tak pohanchti hai.

Tension: transpiration ki kheench se bana manfi dabao. Yeh kam dabao xylem mein phail kar jure hue column ko upar kheenchta hai aur paani musalsal charhta rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: This mechanism depends on both physical and chemical properties of water

blocks.prompt:
11 Describe the structure of phloem tissue and the role of each of its components. (4 marks)
(Phloem tissue ki banawat aur is ke har hisse ka kirdar bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Phloem woh vascular tissue hai jo organic nutrients, khaas kar photosynthesis ki paidawar, patton se un hisson tak le jata hai jahan zaroorat ho ya jama hon. Yeh vascular tissue ke bahar ki taraf hota hai aur secondary growth wale plants mein andar ki bark banata hai. Is ke hisse:

Sieve tube elements: sugar aur doosra organic maadda le jane wale cells. In mein sieve areas hote hain, wall ke woh hisse jahan surakh elements ko jorte hain. End walls ke sieve areas cells ko lambi qatar, sieve tube, mein jorte hain.

Companion cells: har sieve tube element ke saath aik ya zyada; plasmodesmata se raabta rakhte aur use ATP aur proteins dete hain.

Phloem fibres: phloem tissue ka aik hissa (Fig. 8.10).

Phloem parenchyma: sugar, resins, latex aur mucilage jama karta hai jo hifazat aur nami ke liye ahem hain.

book_ref.quote: The phloem is generally found on the outer side of both primary and secondary vascular tissue

blocks.prompt:
12 Why can diffusion not account for the transport of sugar in phloem? Describe how sucrose is loaded at the source and unloaded at the sink according to the pressure-flow theory, and how it then flows. (4 marks)
(Diffusion phloem mein sugar ki transport ki wazahat kyun nahi kar sakta? Pressure-flow theory ke mutabiq source par sucrose kaise load aur sink par kaise unload hoti hai, aur phir kaise behti hai, bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Diffusion bohat sust hai: phloem mein sugar taqreeban 1 meter fi ghanta chalti hai jabke diffusion 1 meter aath saal mein tay karta hai.

Pressure-flow (mass-flow) theory, jo Ernst Munch ne 1930 mein pesh ki, sab se zyada maani hui wazahat hai. Sugar source (jahan banti hai) se sink (jahan kharch ya jama hoti hai) tak jati hai, dono ke darmiyan osmotic pressure ke farq ki wajah se.

Source par loading: mesophyll cells mein bani glucose respiration mein lagti hai aur baqi non-reducing sugar sucrose ban jati hai. Sucrose active transport se companion cells mein aur plasmodesmata se sieve tubes mein jati hai, is liye wahan is ki miqdaar barhti hai. Phir paas ke xylem se paani osmosis se sieve tubes mein aata hai aur source ke sire par dabao banta hai.

Sink par unloading: sugar active tor par sieve tubes se nikali jati hai aur paani bhi osmosis se nikalta hai, is liye sink ke sire par dabao kam hota hai.

Bahao: source aur sink ka yeh farq paani ko source se sink ki taraf bahata hai aur us mein ghuli sucrose saath chali jati hai.

book_ref.quote: The difference in water potential causes water to flow from source to sink

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Source par paani andar aane se sieve tube mein dabao (pressure potential) barhta hai, aur sink par paani nikalne se dabao kam hota hai. Isi dabao ke farq se mehlool (solution) source se sink ki taraf behta hai.

blocks.prompt:
13 Describe the three phases of primary growth in a root, giving the position and the features of the cells of each zone. (4 marks)
(Jar mein primary growth ke teen marahil bayan karein, har zone ki jagah aur us ke cells ki khususiyat ke saath.)
blocks.explanation:
Primary growth plant ki lambai barhati hai aur apical meristems se hoti hai. Yeh teen marahil mein hoti hai:

1. Cell division: apical meristem ke cells taqseem hote hain aur tadaad barhti hai. Yeh jar aur shoot ki nok par, zone of cell division mein hota hai. Cells chhote, bina vacuole ke, aur gol nucleus cytoplasm ke beech mein.

2. Cell elongation: naye cells paani lete hain aur volume barhta hai; wall ki lachak barhti aur wall pressure kam hota hai. Yeh nok se thora peeche, zone of cell elongation mein hota hai. Cells bare, vacuole wale, nucleus kinaron par. Cells mukhtalif simton mein lambe ho kar aakhri size pate hain, maslan xylem banne wale cells pith ya cortex wale cells se zyada lambe hote hain.

3. Cell differentiation: aakhri size aur shakal ke baad elongation ruk jati hai aur cells khaas kaamon ke liye makhsoos ho jate hain; walls moti aur nayi khususiyat banti hain. Yeh zone of elongation ke saath zone of differentiation mein hota hai.

book_ref.quote: The process of primary growth in plants occurs in three phases

blocks.prompt:
14 What are lateral meristems? Explain how vascular cambium and cork cambium bring about secondary growth and the formation of bark. (4 marks)
(Lateral meristems kya hain? Vascular cambium aur cork cambium secondary growth aur bark kaise banate hain, samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Lateral meristems tanon aur jaron ke kinaron ke saath taqseem hone wale cells ke silinder hain. Yeh lakri wale plants mein hote hain, motai barhate hain aur secondary growth ke liye zaroori hain. Secondary growth, yani motai mein izafa, lakri wale perennial plants mein zyada hoti hai.

Vascular cambium: xylem aur phloem ke darmiyan. Is ke cells dono kinaron par naye cells banate hain: bahar wale kinare par secondary phloem aur andar wale par secondary xylem. Secondary tissues, khaas kar secondary xylem, plant ki motai barhate hain.

Cork cambium: tanon aur jaron ki bahari tah mein banta hai. Is ki taqseem dono taraf cells banati hai jo naya cork banate hain. Cork cells epidermis ki jagah le kar bahar ki hifazati bark banate hain.

Bark: pakke tane mein vascular cambium se bahar ka hissa, jis mein secondary phloem, cork cambium aur cork hon, mil kar bark kehlata hai.

book_ref.quote: There are two main forms of lateral meristems; vascular cambium and cork cambium

blocks.prompt:
15 Explain how spring wood and autumn wood are formed and how they make an annual ring. How are annual rings used to find the age of a tree? (4 marks)
(Spring wood aur autumn wood kaise banti hain aur aik annual ring kaise banati hain, samjhayein. Annual rings se darakht ki umar kaise maloom karte hain?)
blocks.explanation:
Annual rings cambium ki mausami activity se banti hain; cambium meristematic tissue hai jo naya xylem aur phloem banata hai. Har saal do qisam ki lakri banti hai:

Spring wood (early wood): bahar mein achhe halaat mein cambium bohat active ho kar chaure vessels wala bohat sa xylem banata hai, is liye lakri halke rang ki hoti hai.

Autumn wood (late wood): khizan mein cambium ki activity kam hoti hai; yeh kam, patle aur ghane xylem elements banata hai, is liye lakri gehri hoti hai.

Annual ring: spring aur autumn wood mil kar aik mukammal annual ring banati hain. Spring se autumn ki tabdeeli aahista hai magar autumn se agli spring ki taraf achanak, jo saalon ke darmiyan saaf had banati hai.

Umar: har saal nayi ring banti hai, is liye rings gin kar umar maloom hoti hai. Yeh dendrochronology se hota hai, darakht ke rings ka scientific mutaala, jis se purane mausam aur lambe arse ki mausami tabdeeli bhi maloom hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Annual rings are formed due to the seasonal activity of the cambium layer in trees

blocks.prompt:
16 What are plant growth regulators? Describe the functions of auxins and gibberellins. (4 marks)
(Plant growth regulators kya hain? Auxins aur gibberellins ke kaam bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Plant growth regulators (plant hormones) khaas chemical paighambar hain jo growth control karte hain. Paanch bare groups: auxins, cytokinins, gibberellins, abscisic acid aur ethylene.

Auxins (indole acetic acid, IAA, ya is ki shakalen):
- Tane mein apex ke peeche cells barhate; cambium mein cell division barhate hain.
- Jar mein bohat kam miqdaar par growth barhate aur zyada par rokte hain (maslan geotropism); cuttings aur callus se jaren nikalte hain.
- Shoots mein kaliyan shuru karte hain (kabhi cytokinins ke mukhalif aur rokne wale).
- Apical dominance aur phal ki growth barhate; kabhi parthenocarpy late; kuch species mein patte ka burhapa (senescence) der se late; abscission rokte hain.

Gibberellins (jaron aur shoots ke sire par bante; gibberellic acid wale; 110 se zyada maloom):
- Auxins ke saath cells barhate aur apical meristem aur cambium mein taqseem barhate hain.
- Kuch rosette plants ki bolting barhate; chrysanthemum callus ke shoots mein kaliyan late hain.
- Patte aur phal ki growth barhate; parthenocarpy la sakte; apical dominance mein auxins ka asar barhate hain.
- Kali aur beej ki dormancy torte; red light ki jagah le sakte, is liye long-day plants mein phool barhate aur short-day mein rokte; kuch species mein senescence der se late hain.

book_ref.quote: Plants regulate the rates of growth and the rate of metabolism in their cells

blocks.prompt:
17 Describe the functions of cytokinins, abscisic acid and ethylene in plants. (4 marks)
(Plants mein cytokinins, abscisic acid aur ethylene ke kaam bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Cytokinins (aam tor par jaron, kachche phalon aur beejon mein bante): cytokinesis barhate aur DNA replication, RNA aur protein banne ki raftaar tez karte hain. Apical meristem aur cambium mein taqseem se tane ki growth barhate; asal jar ki growth rokte magar pehlu ki jaren barhate; kaliyan, patte aur phal ki growth barhate (shaz-o-nadir parthenocarpy); pehlu ki kaliyan barhate aur kali ki dormancy torte; senescence der se late; stomata kholte hain.

Abscisic acid, ABA (zyada tar pakke hare patton, phalon aur root caps mein): khaas kar stress, maslan khushk sali aur paani bhar jane, mein tane aur jar ki growth rokta hai; kali aur beej ki dormancy barhata; short-day plants mein phool barhata aur long-day mein rokta (gibberellins ka mukhalif); kabhi senescence barhata; abscission barhata; paani ki kami (murjhane) mein stomata band karta hai.

Ethylene (plant metabolism ki qudrati paidawar): khaas kar stress mein tane ki growth aur jar ki growth rokta; kali ki dormancy torta; pineapple mein phool lata; phal pakata hai.

book_ref.quote: They perform the following:

blocks.prompt:
18 Define osmoregulation. Explain the effect of hypotonic, hypertonic and isotonic solutions on a plant cell. (4 marks)
(Osmoregulation ki definition likhein. Plant cell par hypotonic, hypertonic aur isotonic solutions ka asar samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Osmoregulation woh amal hai jis se organism paani aur hal shuda cheezon ka andar ka tawazun qaim rakhta hai, bahar ka mahol jaisa bhi ho. Bohat se samandari organisms ko control nahi chahiye kyun ke un ke cells ka osmotic pressure samandar jaisa hai; doosron ko paani ya namak active tor par lena, rokna ya nikalna parta hai.

Hypotonic solution: solute cell ke andar se kam. Paani osmosis se andar aata hai aur cell phool jata hai.

Hypertonic solution: solute cell ke andar se zyada. Paani bahar nikalta hai aur cell sukarta hai; yeh plasmolysis hai.

Isotonic solution: solute cell ke andar jaisa. Cell aur mahol ke darmiyan paani ki khalis harkat zero hai.

book_ref.quote: Hypotonic solution: A solution having reduced solute concentration relative to the intracellular environment of a cell

blocks.prompt:
19 Describe mesophytes and xerophytes, giving their habitat, adaptations and examples. (4 marks)
(Mesophytes aur xerophytes bayan karein, un ke mahol, adaptations aur misalon ke saath.)
blocks.explanation:
Darmiyana mahol ke plants mesophytes aur shadeed khushk zameeni mahol ke plants xerophytes hain.

Mesophytes: darmiyana mahol mein, na zyada khushk na zyada geela. Aisi mitti pasand karte hain jo paani se bhari na ho aur jis mein namak aur nami darmiyani ho. In ki jaren aur shoots achhi tarah bane aur vascular system mukammal hota hai; khaas adaptations nahi chahiye. Patte chapte, chaure aur hare, satah par stomata. Misalein: gulab, tamatar aur daisy.

Xerophytes: khushk halaat mein zinda rehne ke liye dhale hue, paani ka nuqsan kam karne aur paani jama karne ki khaas adaptations ke saath. Paani jama karne wale succulents kehlate hain jin ke gooday daar tane zaroorat ke liye paani rakhte hain. Doosri adaptations: patton par mom ki tah taake paani kam nikle aur khushk mausam mein patte gira dena. Misalein: thorn trees, desert marigold aur blue agave.

book_ref.quote: Mesophytes live in moderate environments that are neither too dry nor too wet

blocks.prompt:
20 How does freezing temperature injure plant cells? Explain how plants native to cold regions survive freezing. (4 marks)
(Jamne wala temperature plant cells ko kaise nuqsan deta hai? Thande ilaqon ke plants jamne se kaise bachte hain, samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Kam temperature pehle cell membrane ki rawani badalta hai: membrane ke lipids crystal ki shakal mein jam jate hain jis se solutes ki transport mutasir hoti hai aur membrane proteins ki structure bhi. Plants unsaturated fatty acids ka tanasub barhate hain jo crystal banne se rok kar membrane ki structure qaim rakhte hain. Is mein waqt lagta hai, is liye achanak thand aahista thand se zyada nuqsan deti hai.

Jamne wala temperature barf ke crystals banata hai. Agar barf sirf cell wall ke gird bane to plant ko zyada nuqsan nahi hota aur woh bach jata hai. Agar crystals protoplasm ke andar banen to membranes aur organelles mein surakh kar ke cells maar dete hain.

Thande ilaqon ke plants, jaise oak, maple aur gulab, ne apne cells ke solutes badal kar adaptation ki hai. Is se cytosol barf ke baghair super cool ho jata hai, agarche cell walls mein barf ban sakti hai.

book_ref.quote: Freezing temperature causes ice crystal formation

blocks.prompt:
21 What are tropic movements? Describe phototropism, geotropism, thigmotropism and chemotropism with examples. (4 marks)
(Tropic movements kya hain? Phototropism, geotropism, thigmotropism aur chemotropism misalon ke saath bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Plants aik jagah jame hain, is liye stimuli ka jawab growth ka andaz badal kar dete hain. Kisi stimulus se hone wali growth ki harkatein tropic movements (tropisms) hain; in mein poora organ roshni, chhoone, chemicals, paani ya gravity ki taraf ya un se door mur jata hai.

Phototropism: roshni ke jawab mein plant ke hisse ki harkat, tane ya jar ki ghair barabar growth se. Shoot ki nok aam tor par positive aur jaren negative phototropism dikhati hain.

Geotropism: gravity ke jawab mein harkat. Jaren positive aur shoots negative geotropism dikhate hain.

Thigmotropism: chhoone ke jawab mein harkat, maslan charhne wali bel. Jab tendril kisi sakht cheez ko chhoota hai to mukhalif taraf growth barhti hai aur tendril sahare ke gird lipat jata hai.

Chemotropism: kuch chemicals ke jawab mein harkat, maslan fungi ki hyphae chemotropic hain.

book_ref.quote: Such movements occur as a curvature of whole organ towards or away from stimuli

blocks.prompt:
22 Describe the work of Garner and Allard on photoperiodism. (i) What did they find in tobacco and how did they classify flowering plants? (ii) How was it later shown that the dark period is critical? (4 marks)
(Photoperiodism par Garner aur Allard ka kaam bayan karein. Tobacco mein unhon ne kya dekha aur phooldar plants ki darja bandi kaise ki? Baad mein kaise sabit hua ke andhere ka arsa asal hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Photoperiodism din aur raat ki lambai ka plants ka jawab hai jo unhein mausami tabdeeliyon ke mutabiq dhalne deta hai.

(i) Is ka asar sab se pehle 1920 mein Garner aur Allard ne study kiya. Unhon ne dekha ke tobacco sirf chhote dinon ke silsile ke baad phool deta hai. Tobacco qudrati tor par khizan mein aise halaat mein phool deta hai, magar masnooi chhote din de kar bhi phool laya ja sakta tha. Mazeed studies se unhon ne phooldar plants ko long-day plants (lambe din chahiye), short-day plants (chhote din chahiye) aur day-neutral plants (photoperiod se azad) mein taqseem kiya.

(ii) Baad ki studies se pata chala ke asal mein andhere ka arsa ahem hai, is liye short-day plants dar-asal long-night plants hain. Agar short-day plants ko chhote dinon mein ugaya jaye magar lambi raat ko thori roshni se tora jaye to phool nahi aate. Long-day plants lambi raat torne par chhote dinon mein bhi phool dete hain. Yani short-day plants critical length se lambe andhere par (cocklebur 8.5 h; tobacco 10-11 h) aur long-day plants critical length se chhote andhere par (henbane 13 h) phool dete hain.

book_ref.quote: Tobacco plant naturally flowers under same conditions, in autumn

blocks.prompt:
23 Explain the interconversion of the two forms of phytochrome and how it was thought to act as a time-regulator for flowering. Why is it now agreed that it is not the only control, and how is flowering finally initiated? (4 marks)
(Phytochrome ki do shakalon ki aapas mein tabdeeli aur yeh phool ke waqt ko control karne wala kaise samjha gaya, samjhayein. Ab kyun maana jata hai ke yeh akela control nahi, aur phool aakhir kaise shuru hota hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Phytochrome aik photoreceptor protein hai jis ki do shakalen hain. P₆₆₀ khamosh shakal hai; yeh red light (660 nm) jazb kar ke active P₇₃₀ banti hai. P₇₃₀ far red light (730 nm) jazb kar ke wapas P₆₆₀ banti hai. Qudrat mein P₆₆₀ din ki roshni mein P₇₃₀ aur P₇₃₀ andhere mein P₆₆₀ banti hai. P₇₃₀ ke P₆₆₀ banne ki raftaar plant ko andhere ka arsa naapne ki ghari deti hai.

Red light short-day plants mein phool rokti aur long-day plants mein barhati hai. Is liye kaha gaya ke P₇₃₀ (red light se bani) short-day plants mein phool rokti aur long-day mein barhati hai. P₇₃₀ din mein jama hoti aur raat ko kam hoti hai; lambi raat itni P₇₃₀ ko wapas P₆₆₀ bana deti hai ke short-day plant ko rokne ke liye kaafi P₇₃₀ nahi bachti aur woh phool deta hai, jabke long-day plants ko chhoti raat ke aakhir mein P₇₃₀ bachi hui chahiye.

Ab maana jata hai ke phool ke waqt ka hisab poori tarah is tabdeeli ke qabze mein nahi; roshni ka hona ya na hona aur andhere ya roshni ke arse ki lambai bhi ahem hain.

Aaghaz: biological clock harkat mein aa kar patton mein florigen hormone banwata hai. Florigen phloem ke raste phool ki kaliyon tak ja kar phool shuru karta hai.

book_ref.quote: This observation led to the hypothesis that the P₇₃₀-P₆₆₀ interconversion might be the plant time-regulator for flowering

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab ki aik line mein likha hai ke short-day plant mein raat ke aakhir mein kaafi P₇₃₀ bach kar phool barhati hai; yeh usi paragraph se takrata hai. Sahi baat: P₇₃₀ short-day plant ko rokti hai, is liye lambi raat mein P₇₃₀ kam ho jane par hi short-day plant phool deta hai.

blocks.prompt:
24 What is vernalisation? Describe the site that receives its stimulus, the temperature and duration required, the hormone involved, and its significance for plants. (4 marks)
(Vernalisation kya hai? Is ke stimulus ko lene wali jagah, zaroori temperature aur arsa, mutaliqa hormone aur plants ke liye is ki ahmiyat bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Vernalisation: biennial aur perennial plants ko kam temperature de kar phool dilana.

Jagah: kam temperature ka asar pakke tane ki shoot apex ya beej ka embryo leta hai, patte nahi jaise photoperiodism mein.

Zaroorat: kuch plants ke liye vernalisation lazmi hai jabke kuch mein yeh sirf phool lane mein madad karta hai. Chilling ka zaroori arsa chaar din se teen mahine tak hai; taqreeban 4°C bohat asar daar hai.

Hormone: kam temperature vernalin hormone banwata hai jo vernalisation laata hai.

Ahmiyat: photoperiodism aur vernalisation plants ke reproduction ko mahol ke saath milate hain taake saal ke munasib waqt par reproduction ho. Yeh aik species ke members ko aik waqt phool dilate hain jis se cross pollination aur genetic variability barhti hai.

book_ref.quote: Biennial and perennial plants are stimulated to flowering by exposure to low temperature
